lines.en: I trot through the dead grass.

lines.zh: 我低头贴着地跑，鼻尖在前。
lines.en: I run with my head low, nose ahead.
I run fast on short legs.
I run and twist my head around.
I run past the edge of the field.
My path curves.
I circle the house once.
The soil pales where I've run.
I stop, sniff, and run again.
I squeeze under the fence.

lines.zh: 我跑到仓库门口，又跑了。
lines.en: I run to the barn door and away.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条后腿，还能跑。
lines.en: I drag a hind leg and can still run.
I hurry along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我跑到水沟那边停下来。
lines.en: I run to the ditch and stop.
I move frantically, and it looks like panic.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回到原地。
lines.en: I circle and come back to the same spot.
I crouch and look all around.

lines.zh: 土里有一丝甜味，我记住了。
lines.en: A trace of sweetness in the soil; noted.

lines.zh: 我在数你的箱子和口袋。
lines.en: I'm counting your chests and pockets.
I hear something far off.

lines.zh: 这一带的土已经不肥了。
lines.en: The soil here has gone poor.

lines.zh: 我在等没人看着的时候。
lines.en: I'm waiting for no one to be watching.
I crouch at the wall base, folded up.
I haven't eaten anything.
I scratch behind my ear.
I rest my chin on the soil.

lines.zh: 你发现我了，那我就不藏了。
lines.en: You've spotted me; then I won't hide.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，嘴里还有东西。
lines.en: I raise my head with something still in my mouth.
Your pocket is bulging.

lines.zh: 你手指一动，我就上前半步。
lines.en: The moment your fingers twitch, I take half a step closer.
If you don't chase, I won't run.

lines.zh: 我一边看你一边往后挪。
lines.en: I watch you and edge backward.
My teeth show, and they're short.
I've remembered where you live.
You'll fall asleep tonight.
The hungry jaws squeeze out half a cry.
I roll under the wall base.

lines.zh: 这一下让我丢了一半东西。
lines.en: The blow makes me drop half of it.
I press to the soil, breathing fast.
My legs shake and I can't stand.
I try to run and fall after two steps.
Blood soaks the soil on me.
I look back at you, teeth bared.
I crawl toward the hole.
I haven't stolen nearly enough.

lines.zh: 那些东西在地上，我能拿。
lines.en: That's on the ground; I can take it.
I walk over slowly, careful.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把就往嘴里塞。
lines.en: I grab a handful and stuff it in.
Not enough to carry home.
I stuff the rest inside my coat.

lines.zh: 你多给一点，我就走远点。
lines.en: A little more and I'll go farther off.
I eat too fast and choke.
When I'm done I run, without stopping.
I've hidden some in my pocket too.
You hit me and I roll once.
I get up and run two paces.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了个东西。
lines.en: The bump makes me drop something.
I slide off along the wall.
I stumble and catch myself.
You're much heavier than me.
I glance back without stopping.
I dart behind your legs.

lines.zh: 泥被我们踩得到处都是。
lines.en: We trample mud everywhere.
I shake the earth off my back.
She's in this field too.
Both of us keep our heads down.

lines.zh: 她把偷来的东西分给我。
lines.en: She shares what she stole.

lines.zh: 我们没有叫，只是碰了碰鼻子。
lines.en: We don't call; we only touch noses.
Her legs are a little shorter.
She pushes the soil aside.
We crouch in the pit, quiet.
She runs first; I follow.

lines.zh: 这一片地够我们两个偷。
lines.en: This field is enough for us both to rob.
I snatch it up and run.

lines.zh: 我塞进嘴里，腮帮子鼓着。
lines.en: I stuff it in; my cheeks bulge.
I carry it and walk crooked.
Too heavy; I drop half.
I hold it in my mouth without chewing.
I dig it out of the soil.
Things fall from me as I run.
I hide it behind a stone.
I take it and go without a second look.
It smells of someone else.
I smell it — food.
I raise my head and my eyes fix.
I start edging that way.

lines.zh: 我等你不看着我的时候。
lines.en: I wait for you to look away.
It's sitting there, unwatched.
I can carry this off.
I crouch, ready to dash.
First I steal it, then I run.

lines.zh: 我记住了来的那条路线。
lines.en: I've memorized the route I came by.
I've memorized the route.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候就是机会。
lines.en: Your turning away is my chance.
I keep to the wall and follow.
You haven't looked back — good.
I shift step by step, very quietly.
I slip under the table.
I reach out and test the distance.
It's in the chest, and the chest is unlocked.
I grab a handful into my coat.
I start backing toward the door.
A sound at the door and I freeze.
I run for the hole in the corner.
That hole is one I dug myself.
No one follows outside.
I lunge and bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把土扔你眼睛。
lines.en: I throw a fistful of dirt at your eyes.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，想把你绊倒。
lines.en: I ram your knee to trip you.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的背，我扭开了。
lines.en: You grab my back and I twist free.
I fight while watching for a way out.
That bite was shallow.
I kick a bucket over in your way.

lines.zh: 我把偷的东西扔向另一边。
lines.en: I throw the stolen goods the other way.
You look away, and I run.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil and shake.
There's food-smell here.
I drop low and run for the wall.
My nose goes to the ground.

lines.zh: 我在墙根下面找了个洞。
lines.en: I find a hole under the wall base.
The soil here is still soft.
I hear footsteps above.
It's dark — just right.
I start looking for what can be stolen.
Fire catches my fur and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我掉进坑里，摔在硬土上。
lines.en: I drop into a pit onto hard earth.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抓着草根。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I grab at roots.
The blast throws me several paces.
An arrow pins my lower back.

lines.zh: 那道光一照，我腿就软了。
lines.en: The light hits and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 饿得跑不动，我趴在土里。
lines.en: Too starved to run, I lie in the dirt.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我钻得比谁都快。
lines.en: At the thunder I burrow faster than anyone.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我什么都抓不住。
lines.en: No soil under me; I catch nothing.
